paper_scope: non-rescuing aggregation-sensitivity audit for the generic Decision Corpus predictor benchmark

entry_gate.zero_pair_task_action: emit NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FULL_TASK_UNIVERSE and do not compute the full-cohort impact headline

task_weight_identity.run_count: R_t is the number of eligible physical runs for task t in the closed cohort
task_weight_identity.structural_pair_count: S_t is the number of exact-common-support canonical sibling pairs before truth-tie or evaluability filtering
task_weight_identity.informative_pair_count: I_t is the number of pairs retained by the experiment-specific frozen truth and evaluability rules

arm_audit.task_metric: a_m_t is the arithmetic mean tie-aware pair credit for arm m within task t on informative exact common support
arm_audit.realized_fractions: absolute observed component divided by its matching W_m*TV bound, or null when the denominator is zero

contrast_audit.task_metric: c_ab_t is the within-task arithmetic mean of pair-level credit_a-credit_b on exact common support
contrast_audit.sharp_bounds: apply W_ab times the matching run-to-structural, structural-to-informative, and run-to-informative TV to the two components and total
contrast_audit.ranking_flip_rule: PAIR_VS_RUN_SIGN_FLIP only when C_pair_ab*C_run_ab<0; equality to zero is reported separately as ON_BOUNDARY

related_work_boundary.informative_cluster_size_reference: Williamson, Datta, and Satten (2003), Biometrics, doi:10.1111/1541-0420.00005
related_work_boundary.estimand_reference: Kahan, Li, Copas, and Harhay (2023), International Journal of Epidemiology, doi:10.1093/ije/dyac131
novelty_not_claimed: the algebra of size-biased cluster weighting
the general distinction between cluster-average and unit-average estimands
macro versus micro averaging in isolation
related_work_boundary.local_contribution_boundary: an outcome-blind chronological audit showing that task-specific decision-opportunity yield in a real MLE-agent search process endogenously changes the task mixture of a derived sibling-pair benchmark, plus a machine-frozen non-rescuing impact audit
